      sql:   SELECT p.portfolio_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) as sector_count, COUNT(h.holding_id) as holding_count, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(h.holding_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id), 2) as holdings_per_sector FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id HAVING sector_count > 5 ORDER BY sector_count DESC
